plugins.name: consult
plugins.description: Second opinions from independent frontier models via OpenRouter: /consult:2nd for one advisor, /consult:panel for a full panel with a forced decision.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Session resume memory: /handoff:handoff overwrites HANDOFF.md with the live state of the work, and a SessionStart hook injects it into the next session — clear or close any time, pick up cold with zero context.
